item.title: AI Code Generation Disclosure
item.description: AI-assisted code generation was used in building MetaLoom. This page states when that started, what it covers, and what it does not change. It exists because you should not have to reverse-engineer the provenance of a codebase you are considering deploying.

item.title: Impressum
item.description: This page is in German: it is the legal disclosure required of a website operated from Austria (§ 5 E-Commerce-Gesetz, § 25 Mediengesetz). The rest of the site — including the licensing information — is in English.

item.title: Model Licenses
item.description: MetaLoom ships no model weights. Every node that needs a model references it by file path, repository id or endpoint URL, and you provide the model. That means the license you have to satisfy is the one attached to the model you point the node at — not the Apache-2.0 license of MetaLoom itself.
